auth.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: A confirmation link is on its way. Follow it to activate your account — it lasts 24 hours.
sent.resetBody: A link is on its way. Open it to choose a new password — it lasts one hour.

error.taken: That address already has an account. Sign in instead.
error.unverified: Your address is not confirmed yet. The link is in your inbox.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

verification.doneBody: Your account is active and you are signed in.
verification.failedBody: It may already have been used, or it expired. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.body: It signs you in straight away. Devices already signed in will be signed out.
reset.doneBody: You are signed in with your new password.
reset.expiredBody: It may already have been used, or it expired. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.lead: Erases your account and everything in it, for good. This cannot be undone.
delete.goesAccount: Your account and your email address
delete.goesProfile: Your profile: measurements, activity and goal
delete.staysReports: The problems you reported are kept, but detached from your account: they still help fix the site.
delete.failed: The deletion failed. Try again in a moment.
